scope: opened D018 ID corpus; one frozen E11 diffusion checkpoint; no training

method.primary_control: exact expectation over uniform four-of-16 subsets
method.operational_baseline: first four candidates from the identical pool
method.selection: hard-valid candidates first, then reference-free physics score and trajectory diversity
method.selection_inputs: visible frame zero, selected mask, force vector and generated poses
method.selection_does_not_use: reference futures, hidden physics, ADE or tracker output

oracle_four.scope: uses the reference future and is unavailable at inference

interpretation: The selector is not an accuracy improvement: its ADE is 5.28% worse than the exact uniform-four expectation. It raises expected complete clips from 237.25 to 240 and filters penetration and boundary failures, but those geometry definitions are part of its score rather than independent evidence. The oracle reaches 0.01245 ADE only by using the reference future, which no selector has at inference, so it is not an achievable target. The selector is not promoted to the public sampler.
limitations: one checkpoint and the D018 ID split only
16 candidates cost four times as many model samples as four direct outputs
the selector checks necessary visible constraints, not full physical correctness
uniform ADE is the exact expectation over complete candidates; missing-clip expectation is reported separately
ADE and the oracle are diagnostics against one realized hidden-physics reference

provenance.note: Hashes identify the measured snapshot; later changes were locked formatting and administrative renumbering from D031 to D036.
